description: Source code implementing HTTP/2 protocol structures and operators, including frame headers, priority fields, settings, and other HTTP/2 frame components.

classes.name: Http2FrameHeader
classes.description: Represents the header of an HTTP/2 frame, including methods for string representation and response detection.

classes.name: Http2PriorityFields
classes.description: Represents the priority fields of an HTTP/2 stream, including stream dependency, weight, and exclusivity.

classes.name: Http2RstStreamFields
classes.description: Represents the RST_STREAM frame fields, primarily the error code.

classes.name: Http2SettingFields
classes.description: Represents HTTP/2 settings parameters and their values.

classes.name: Http2PushPromiseFields
classes.description: Represents the push promise frame's promised stream ID.

classes.name: Http2PingFields
classes.description: Represents the PING frame's opaque bytes.

classes.name: Http2GoAwayFields
classes.description: Represents the GOAWAY frame's last stream ID and error code.

classes.name: Http2WindowUpdateFields
classes.description: Represents the WINDOW_UPDATE frame's window size increment.

classes.name: Http2AltSvcFields
classes.description: Represents the ALTSVC frame's origin length.

classes.name: Http2PriorityUpdateFields
classes.description: Represents the PRIORITY_UPDATE frame's prioritized stream ID.

methods.name: IsProbableHttpResponse
methods.description: Determines if the frame header likely corresponds to an HTTP response based on payload length, type, and flags.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the frame header or other frame fields.

methods.name: FlagsToString
methods.description: Converts frame flags to a string representation.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator overloads for comparing frame structures.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Stream insertion operator overloads for outputting frame structures.
